headline: Cleveland and Minnesota meet in non-conference showdown
description: Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (1-1, ninth in the Eastern Conference)

headline: Mussolini's great-grandson scores first goal for Lazio
description: Romano Floriani Mussolini, the great-grandson of former Italian dictator Benito Mussolini, scored his first goal for Lazio on Tuesday.

headline: Carabao Cup quarterfinal draw: Liverpool to face Bournemouth
description: Liverpool will host fellow Premier League side Bournemouth in the Carabao Cup quarterfinals after making it past Chelsea in a penalty shootout on Wednesday.
